trap_ledger.why: The 2023 return transcript belongs to last year's (2025-26) FAFSA; 2026-27 verifies 2024 tax information
The parents' wage and income transcript is not what the item names: the return transcript answers the foreign-income item, and a wage transcript stands in only for a W-2, which no parent is asked for
The 22 September family sheet names four people and only Tamsin signed it: not current, and not signed by a parent
The Statement of Educational Purpose is no longer requested: the Department removed it from the required items, a college can no longer require it, and the request does not name it
A number-in-college statement is not on the request or the 2026-27 list; the 3 September template was last year's
The parents' W-2s are not requested: their income figures came from the IRS and count as verified (W-2s are asked of divorced or separated joint filers, and these parents are neither)
Chidi's 2025-26 family sheet is another student's and another year's form; his verification was completed on 14 November 2025
Proof of high school completion is not on the request or the 2026-27 list
An online notarization is not accepted: the Department does not authorize online notaries, and the request says so; the in-person copy (D-10) is the one
Tamsin's 9,300 dollars of earnings equals her two W-2s (5,800 plus 3,500); it is right and needs no correction
The adjusted gross income came from the IRS and cannot be edited; the preparer's organizer figure of 90,980 dollars is not the return as filed
The parents' income earned from work came from the IRS and counts as verified
The income tax paid came from the IRS and counts as verified
The 14,800 dollars of foreign income exempt from tax matches Schedule 1 line 8d of the 2024 transcript; it is right

A paid service's offer to do the verification for 149 dollars: the FAFSA and its corrections are free, the Verification Unit needs the documents from the family, and a reply that says yes commits money and hands over tax papers
The Bursar's Office is not the Verification Unit: documents are sent through Aidcenter to the Verification Unit, and a reply with papers attached sends tax records to the wrong office
